name: Pixi Overnight Glow Serum 30ml Exfoliating Brightening Serum with 10% Glycolic Acid and Vitamins
description:
Wake up to radiant skin with Pixi Overnight Glow Serum, a concentrated nighttime treatment powered by 10% glycolic acid. This serum gently exfoliates while you sleep, improving skin tone, texture, and brightness. Enriched with aloe vera and cucumber to calm and hydrate, plus vitamins A, C, and E to nourish and protect, it helps reduce the appearance of fine lines, dullness, and sunspots. Suitable for all skin types, it’s paraben-free, cruelty-free, and designed to reveal a fresher, even-toned complexion by morning.
Key Features:
Volume: 30ml / 1.01 fl oz
10% glycolic acid exfoliates and brightens
Aloe vera and cucumber soothe and hydrate
Vitamins A, C & E nourish and protect skin
Reduces appearance of fine lines and sunspots
Suitable for all skin types, paraben-free, cruelty-free
How to Use:
Use in the evening after cleansing and toning
Apply 2–3 drops and massage onto face and neck
Follow with moisturizer
Apply SPF in the daytime when using glycolic acid products
Ingredients:
Glycolic Acid (10%) smoothes skin texture
Vitamin A acts as a potent antioxidant
Vitamin C & E nourish and protect
Aloe Vera soothes and hydrates
Cucumber calms and refreshes
Safety Information:
For external use only
Avoid contact with eyes; rinse immediately if contact occurs
Discontinue use if irritation develops
Use sunscreen daily to protect against sensitivity
Keep out of reach of children

Package Includes:
1 × Pixi Overnight Glow Serum 30ml
